foundations: the ecommerce assets contain exactly six digital-colleague definitions, 37 Logic identities and ten canonical shared Capability definitions
all 37 Logic entries resolve to one of the six agent template IDs and all referenced capability IDs resolve to the ten-item catalog
A6E provides immutable AgentTemplate, SkillTemplate and CapabilityRevision authorities while keeping runtime readiness blocked until bindings are operational
ResponsibilityPlanRevision has PostgreSQL authority, exact templateRef, slot assignee refs, coverage, blockers and strict frontend parsing
AgentInstance, SkillBinding and CapabilityBinding have tenant-scoped stores with version, lifecycle, health and Receipt foundations

findings.finding: solution.ecommerce.growth is now 1.3.0 but AipSolutionPackPublisher hard-codes 1.2.0; the canonical catalog/install API test deterministically rejects the current bundle as unsupported.

the production aip_production_contracts router constructs AipProductionContractStore without a ResponsibilityTemplateResolver, so real ResponsibilityPlan creation fails closed with RESPONSIBILITY_TEMPLATE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.
all eight Workshop module descriptors have empty responsibilityTemplateRefs; no installed exact template can be resolved from the module lock.
there is no canonical assignee resolver or ranked deterministic selection Receipt; callers submit an assignee directly in each slot.
the contract advertises agent_instance, human_principal, tool_binding and provider_capability_binding, but the backend dependency check rejects every kind except agent_instance.
Responsibility readiness reduces SkillBinding and CapabilityBinding refs to bare capability identifiers, dropping revision, content hash and binding identity from the comparison.

readiness intersects an assignee's SkillBinding capabilities with all active healthy capability bindings in the tenant, not bindings assigned or authorized for that exact assignee, account, tool or provider.
assignee validation checks AgentInstance existence and version but not active status, template exact ref, policy, current health, route/model/provider readiness, freshness or capacity.
no canonical ResponsibilityPlan reassign, human takeover or immutable resolver decision path was found; generic Handoff does not mutate responsibility authority.
W3-07 and W4-08 remain unchecked, so W6-01 cannot enter implementation or be marked complete even if the catalog layer is repaired.
